_meta.indication: BEOVU is indicated for the treatment of Neovascular (Wet) Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD).

pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3, multicenter, randomized (1:1:1), double-masked, active-controlled, parallel group study; brolucizumab 3 mg vs brolucizumab 6 mg vs aflibercept 2 mg
pivotal_trials.population: Subjects with neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration in the study eye
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change in BCVA from Baseline to Week 48 (non-inferiority to aflibercept, 4-letter margin)
pivotal_trials.n: 1082 randomized (brolucizumab 3 mg 360; brolucizumab 6 mg 361; aflibercept 2 mg 361)
pivotal_trials.result: At Week 48, LS mean change in BCVA: brolucizumab 6 mg 6.6 letters vs aflibercept 6.8 letters; treatment difference -0.2 letters (95% CI -2.1, 1.8); non-inferiority met (1-sided p<0.0001).

nct_ctgov.title: Efficacy and Safety of RTH258 Versus Aflibercept - Study 1

pivotal_trials.design: Two-year, randomized, double-masked, multicenter, two-arm study; brolucizumab 6 mg vs aflibercept 2 mg
pivotal_trials.population: Subjects with neovascular age-related macular degeneration in the study eye
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change in BCVA from Baseline to Week 48 (non-inferiority to aflibercept)
pivotal_trials.result: At Week 48, LS mean change in BCVA: brolucizumab 6 mg 6.9 letters vs aflibercept 7.6 letters; treatment difference -0.7 letters (95% CI -2.4, 1.0), meeting the non-inferiority margin.

nct_ctgov.title: Efficacy and Safety of RTH258 Versus Aflibercept - Study 2

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥5%) with BEOVU: vision blurred 10%, cataract 7%, conjunctival hemorrhage 6%, eye pain 5%, and vitreous floaters 5%. Intraocular inflammation occurred in 4% (vs 1% aflibercept).
target_moa: Brolucizumab is a humanized single-chain Fv antibody fragment (scFv) inhibitor of VEGF-A that inhibits binding of VEGF to the VEGFR1 and VEGFR2 receptors.

rems.type: No risk management activities were recommended beyond routine monitoring and reporting of adverse events.

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee Meeting was held for this application.

description.text: Added treatment of diabetic macular edema (DME)

citations.quote: BLA 761125/S008 – Treatment of diabetic macular edema (DME)

basis.text: This BLA was designated as a Priority review per the Medical Officer Review cover page.

summary.text: BEOVU (brolucizumab-dbl) BLA 761125 was submitted February 7, 2019 with a PDUFA goal date of October 7, 2019 and approved as a priority review based on the HAWK (RTH258-C001) and HARRIER (RTH258-C002) non-inferiority trials versus aflibercept. No advisory committee was convened, and only CMC post-marketing commitments were required.

citations.quote: Studies RTH258-C001 and RTH258-C002 demonstrated that brolucizumab (6 mg/ 0.05 mL) is not inferior to aflibercept with respect to the change in best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) from baseline to Week 48.
No Advisory Committee Meeting was held for this application.
